Expected: Each record stores a sanitized receipt path/name that remains associated with the record and opens through authorized bucket access; no raw local path or invalid storage path is exposed.
Actual: submitted with "QA receipt #1 (copy).pdf" → EXP-1023 | stored/displayed receipt name: QA-receipt-1-copy-.pdf | ✔ stored name is sanitized (no spaces, #, parentheses, or local path) | ✔ sanitized receipt opens through authorized bucket access | RESTRICTED: the "browser path prefix" variant (C: akepath...) cannot be produced by browser automation: the File object exposes only the bare name, so the prefix-stripping branch was not exercised. Spaces, #, and parentheses were exercised and verified.
description: Submit connected expenses using synthetic receipt names with spaces, #, parentheses, and a browser path prefix.
expectedResult: Each record stores a sanitized receipt path/name that remains associated with the record and opens through authorized bucket access; no raw local path or invalid storage path is exposed.
